newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel stable.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady amid good supply on Monday, traders said.
A regular buyer said he saw two E-4 cargoes offered in NWE at around $6 a tonne over the mean/mean/mean of published quotes, as well as an M-100 cargo loading at the end of this month.
A refiner was heard to have bought a low sulphur Russian straight-run piece in the Med on Friday at $6 a tonne over the quoted cif high.
An Italian refiner bought a Russian straight-run piece on Friday from a trader, also in the Med, but more details were not known.
But markets were quiet on Monday. "It is deadly quiet," one said.
